title: Trace enumeration, deferred iterator execution and enumerator disposal on normal exit or failure

rubric.point: States that `foreach` wraps its loop in a `try`/`finally` (or equivalent) that disposes the enumerator when the loop exits, including on `break`.
States that disposing the iterator's enumerator runs the iterator's pending `finally` block, which prints `closed`.

questions.model: The compiler lowers `foreach` to a `try`/`finally` that disposes the enumerator however the loop ends, including on `break`. Disposing an iterator's enumerator runs any `finally` block that is still pending in the iterator body, so `closed` is printed.

options: `closed` prints when `e` goes out of scope, because leaving the enclosing method makes the state machine run its pending `finally`.
